name: Risperidone
executiveSummary: Atypical antipsychotic. Adult psychosis: start **1–2 mg/day** → **4–6 mg/day** (usual max **8–16 mg**). Agitation/dementia (off-label): **0.25–1 mg/day**. Pediatric ASD irritability (≥5 y): **0.25–0.5 mg/day** titrate. Depot IM every 2 weeks per label.
indications:
## Indications

- Schizophrenia; bipolar mania; irritability in ASD (authorized ages).

## Precautions

- Dose-dependent EPS; hyperprolactinemia; ↑ weight/glucose/lipids.
- Elderly dementia: ↑ stroke/mortality.
- QT, orthostatic hypotension at start.

> Oral solution helps low-dose titration.

adulto.presentation: Tabs 0.5–1–2–3–4 mg; solution 1 mg/mL; depot IM.
adulto.dose: Psychosis: **1 mg q12h** day 1 → increase **1 mg/day** to **4–6 mg/day**. Elderly: start **0.5 mg q12h**. Usual max **8 mg/day** (up to 16 on labels). Depot: after PO stabilization, per brand (e.g. 25 mg/2 wk).
adulto.administration: PO; depot IM gluteal/deltoid per label.

pediatrico.dose: ASD irritability ≥5 y: **0.25 mg/day** (<20 kg) or **0.5 mg** (≥20 kg) → titrate to **0.5–3 mg/day**. Adolescent psychosis: specialist regimens.

stability:
## Stability

- Solution: per label after opening.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Somnolence, weight gain, EPS, hyperprolactinemia, hypotension; rare: NMS, priapism.

bibliography.citation: FDA. Risperidone — labeling and dementia warning.
